bagPolicy.summary: Fans may bring one clear bag up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches or one one-gallon plastic storage bag, plus a small clutch or purse for privacy.
allowed: One clear bag up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
prohibited: Bags that do not meet the clear-bag policy
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking at the arena and surrounding lots serves basketball, volleyball, acrobatics and tumbling, concerts, and events. Guests should use the event parking map because inventory and pricing vary.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published specific rideshare guidance on its official venue or guest-information pages.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Athletics concessions are cashless and accept Visa, Mastercard, and Discover. Outside cans, bottles, coolers, and food or beverage containers are prohibited inside Matthew Knight Arena.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible seating is available through the arena ticket office. Limited accessible parking is in the arena garage, with additional spaces on Columbia Street west of the arena.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: Re-entry is not permitted at Matthew Knight Arena.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: Men’s basketball will call is at the West Box Office, opening 90 minutes before tipoff and closing at halftime. Photo ID is required.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: Doors open one hour before tipoff. Student-athlete guest admission begins 60 minutes before tipoff at the West Gate.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
